title: Hearth Yard proof scene

setting.mapIntent: Use the existing small yard layout as a quiet first meeting; place the two speakers on reachable ground and leave the cottage and chest unobstructed.
placementConstraints: Do not place actors on water or solid building footprints
Keep the chest reachable from the yard spawn

participants.startingSituation: At the cottage entrance, standing still.
Near the edge of the yard, standing still.

uses.purpose: Show a short, manually advanced line from each existing map speaker.
Use the existing validated interaction/action flow for authored scene dialogue.
Use the already-authored chest interaction and reward as an optional nearby activity.

beats.intent: Wren greets the player and points out that the chest was left for travelers.
beats.speaker: healer-wren
beats.text: Welcome in. There are a few supplies in that chest for anyone setting out.

beats.intent: The villager warmly confirms that Wren keeps the yard open.
beats.speaker: yard-villager
beats.text: She always makes room for one more traveler.

beats.intent: The player may walk to the existing chest and interact with it.
beats.interactionIntent: Open the yard chest using the current chest interaction.
beats.expectedResult: The existing pack reward is granted once and its milestone persists after reload.

beats.intent: The conversation ends; the player remains free to explore the yard.
beats.expectedResult: The welcome fact wren-welcomes-travelers is established; the player remains free to explore the yard.

completion: The two authored dialogue lines advance manually, the player reaches the existing chest, its reward is granted once, and a reload preserves the completion flag.

canonicalFacts.statement: Healer Wren welcomes travelers and keeps supplies in the yard chest.

pendingThreads: The player may ask Wren about the road in a later scene.
